question: Which of the following states/Union Territories have the highest male literacy rate according to Census of India 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** has the highest male literacy rate according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The male literacy rate in Kerala is significantly higher compared to other states and Union Territories.
 
• Kerala has consistently been at the forefront of literacy rates in India due to its strong emphasis on education and effective implementation of educational policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The literacy rate is an important indicator of the educational status of a region.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years to collect demographic data, including literacy rates, across the country.
 
• Kerala's high literacy rate is attributed to its historical focus on education and progressive social policies.
 
• Improving literacy rates has been a key goal for the Indian government to enhance socio-economic development.
